his incident.

Two things about the process:

The judge was useful. It refused to validate my main finding, because the evidence I gave it had no complaint record in it. That was a real fault in my evidence list, not in the finding — the complaint time (`07:27:27Z`, 22 s after the switch) settles it. The judge also found a hypothesis I missed: the process start could be a restart. I cannot answer that from the permitted surface, so the journal records it as open.

I did not commit the journal. A manual `/konan` run has no reason to commit, and your working tree has other journal changes in it.
